item.title: Dec 12, 2026 — 📍 West Art · Holiday Dueling Pianos: Festive Favorites & Loud Singalongs!
item.description:
Events: Dec 12, 2026

Location: West Art, City Hall

Price: Not supplied by this source; check event details

We’re thrilled to bring Dueling Pianos back to West Art for a special holiday celebration! Featuring two pianos, fearless pianists, and a room full of people calling the shots, this high-energy, wildly interactive show is led by Love Me Duel—Mary and Devin Calderin, a husband-and-wife duo who have been performing together since 2017. Joining Mary and Devin on stage is the wonderful Alex Wash, dueling pianist extraordinaire with nearly two decades of experience in the business. Here’s how it works: you request the songs, and our pianists will perform them on the spot, complete with clever quips, playful banter, and massive sing-alongs. Think of it as a live concert where the audience chooses the entire setlist in real time, with extra holiday magic thrown in! From Christmas classics to seasonal favorites, Billy Joel to Beyoncé, Mariah Carey to Bing Crosby, and everything in between, no genre is off-limits! Guests can also include a tip with their requests to move songs up in the queue, adding a fun, playfully competitive twist to the night. Expect an evening full of festive fun and joyful chaos, with singing, clapping, dancing, laughter, and plenty of surprises along the way! Throughout the show, our musicians may invite audience members up front or on stage for lighthearted contests, singalongs, and special celebrations. Whether you're gathering with friends, planning a holiday outing, or simply looking for a fun night out, this is all about bringing people together through music, laughter, and unforgettable memories. We're glad to offer seated general admission, along with the option to reserve a four-person table up front if you want to scale up the fun! Seating is limited, and this special holiday show is expected to sell out—grab your tickets early to guarantee your spot!
